idea_name: RSI–DeMarker hidden divergence with slope filter
mechanism: Long when price makes a lower low while both RSI and DeMarker make higher lows (hidden bullish divergence), with RSI < 30, DeMarker < 0.4, and RSI slope over 3 bars > 0. Isolates continuation after pullback rather than classic divergence reversals. Long-only NVDA patterns; sell mirror defined but unused in this pack.
data_needed: RSI(n≈14), DeMarker, High/Low series; 3-bar RSI slope; oversold thresholds
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NVDA; H4; train 2021-08-01→2023-06-01, forward 2023-06-01→2024-06-01 (between stock splits)
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a dual-oscillator hidden-divergence + short-horizon slope channel for continuation-after-pullback regime flips, not just classic overbought/oversold.
quote: Price makes a lower low while both RSI and DeMarker make higher lows (hidden bullish divergence) and RSI slope(3) > 0.

mechanism: Detect narrowing high–low band over m_past bars (prior range > recent range), then require close above prior range high with RSI rising vs m_past and DeMarker rising. Optional strengthening when oscillators print higher lows during compression. Explicitly framed as calm-before-storm / low-ATR phases preceding directional expansion.
data_needed: High/Low range over optimizable m_past; RSI; DeMarker; optional ATR
why_new_for_mis: Pairs a measurable range-compression sensor with breakout confirmation—MIS can stream contraction→expansion state as a volatility-regime channel.
quote: Price has been in a narrow range (ATR small / narrow high-low band for 8 bars) and then breaks above range high with RSI > RSI.mean(20) and DeMarker rising

mechanism: Buy when RSI slope(3)>0 and DeMarker slope(3)>0 while current bar range exceeds a past benchmark range (and conceptually >1.2× avg range/10 with close in top 25% of bar). Filters for simultaneous momentum acceleration and volatility expansion after compression.
data_needed: RSI/DeMarker 3-bar slopes; High–Low ranges; optional avg range(10)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NVDA; M15 forward walk 2023-06-01→2024-06-01 also shown for pattern-5
why_new_for_mis: A concrete dual-slope + range-expansion conviction sensor MIS can use as a volatility-burst / activity-regime flag.
quote: RSI slope(3) > 0, DeMarker slope(3) > 0, AND current bar range (high-low) > 1.2 * average(range,10) … price must close in top 25% of bar.

mechanism: Require RSI slope monotone positive across 1-, 3-, and 5-bar horizons AND DeMarker slope(1)>0 (mirror for shorts). Stacks short→medium→longer momentum filters so only aligned multi-scale trends fire—no price-structure gate in this pattern.
data_needed: RSI values at offsets 1/3/5; DeMarker offset 1
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NVDA; train/forward split-gap window as Parts 1–2
why_new_for_mis: Treats multi-horizon oscillator-slope agreement as a regime-alignment sensor—MIS can score how many nested slope horizons concur as trend-strength state.
quote: RSI slope(1)>0, slope(3)>0, slope(5)>0 (monotone positive slopes across short→long) AND DeMarker slope(1)>0.

mechanism: Bear-trap long: price closes below a support/EMA for ~2 bars then reclaims above within 3 bars while RSI and DeMarker slopes turn positive (price break not confirmed by oscillators). Detects failed breaks / liquidity grabs as asymmetric entry contexts.
data_needed: Close vs dynamic EMA/support; RSI/DeMarker 1-bar slopes; 3-bar reclaim window
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NVDA long-only in bullish split-gap window
why_new_for_mis: Formalizes failed-break / trap reclaim as a discrete change sensor with oscillator veto—useful MIS channel for fakeout vs genuine break regimes.
quote: Price briefly breaks below a support … but within 3 bars reclaims support … AND RSI did not confirm (RSI did not make new low) while DeMarker showed rising slope

mechanism: Ten discrete RSI–DeMarker patterns gated by m_patterns_usage bit-mask (0–1023); LongCondition averages weights of active fired patterns and ShortCondition returns 0. One-sided voting stops long/short patterns from cancelling each other—tested combo 605 = patterns 0,2,3,4,6,9.
data_needed: Per-pattern boolean IsPattern_i; integer bit-mask; optional pattern weights
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NVDA; same windows; multi-pattern forward vs single-pattern baselines
why_new_for_mis: Shows ensemble bit-mask voting of heterogeneous micro-sensors as a coherent decision layer—MIS can stream both individual pattern bits and the aggregated vote as state.
quote: each of the ten signal patterns … can independently appraise for bullish conditions … m_patterns_usage that acts as a bit-mask

idea_name: CSV IPC for Python ML under Strategy Tester
mechanism: Because WebRequest/sockets are blocked in the tester, MQL5 writes init.csv (host/port/typerun Test|Live) and exchanges CSV messages with a Python server; live path uses sockets, tester path uses files. Article is messaging/architecture POC plus a toy linear-regression demo—no market sensor is built.
data_needed: Common Files TransferML CSVs; Python File service; model I/O schema
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic; EURUSD M1 speed test for 100 CSV round-trips
why_new_for_mis: No new market sensing idea after full read—tester/Python IPC plumbing only.
quote: WebRequest() cannot run in the Strategy Tester

idea_name: Heikin-Ashi break of EMA20 envelope gated by EMA50 slope
mechanism: Compute HA OHLC; EMA20 on highs and lows as short-term envelope; EMA50 on closes with slope = ema50_current ? ema50_previous as trend bias. Buy only if HA bullish, HA close > EMA20_high, HA close > EMA50, EMA50 rising, and prior HA close was below EMA50 (breakout context). Rejects visually strong HA candles that oppose EMA50 slope.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Commodities, synthetic indices, forex; default WorkTF=M15; H1 backtest example; Step Index / Gold Basket demos
why_new_for_mis: Fuses smoothed candle structure with envelope break and slope-based regime gate—MIS can publish HA-vs-EMA50 alignment as a trend-regime filter independent of raw OHLC noise.
quote: Before a Heikin‑Ashi signal is accepted, it must break beyond these EMA20 boundaries and agree with the EMA50 slope.

mechanism: Compare recent window (default 30 bars) to prior window: contraction ratio, candle overlap ratio, absolute/relative box tightness, boundary tests, rejection wicks. Additive score maps to None/Early/Building/Mature. Defenses: trimmed envelope (drop extreme wicks), invalidate on close-out, dead-drift filter when box << avg candle range. Closed-bar only, non-repainting.
data_needed: OHLC windows; InpContractionMax, InpOverlapMin, score thresholds; optional trim/dead-drift params
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD primary live/backtest demos; any symbol/TF via inputs
why_new_for_mis: Turns VCP/squeeze intuition into an explicit maturity-state machine MIS can stream as volatility-regime (compressing→ready) rather than a binary squeeze flag.

idea_name: CLV mean plus rejection-asymmetry absorption bias
mechanism: Mean Close Location Value over short lookback locates closes within candle ranges; rejection asymmetry counts upper-wick failed advances vs lower-wick defended declines. Combined raw bias → bullish/bearish/neutral with qualitative strength; optional smoothing. Bias is independent of maturity grade and uses candle geometry only.
data_needed: Per-bar CLV=(2c−h−l)/(h−l); upper/lower wick sizes vs InpRejectionMinPts; InpCLVMeanBars
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD examples; panel reports bias separately from maturity
why_new_for_mis: Provides a pure price-geometry absorption/pressure sensor MIS can pair with compression maturity without needing volume or external indicators.
quote: Directional bias is derived exclusively from candle structure. The mean Close Location Value (CLV) … Rejection asymmetry compares upper-wick rejections … against lower-wick rejections

idea_name: Flagpole height buffer as structure-proportional risk sensor
mechanism: Flag detector publishes BufferBuy/BufferSell on closed-bar breakout plus BufferPoleHeight = measured pole length on the same bar. EA sizes SL/TP as price ± poleHeight×multipliers (fallback to fixed points). ATR(20) used in pole/move detection; MaxRetracePercent invalidates flags that retrace too far.
data_needed: Pole start/end extremes; ATR(20); CopyBuffer of buy/sell/pole-height; SL/TP multipliers
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H4 backtest 2022-10-11→2026-05-14 (98% tick quality); chart examples on XAUUSD
why_new_for_mis: Exposes pattern geometric size as a first-class volatility/structure channel—MIS can use pole height (and retrace%) as continuous regime amplitude, not only as trade sizing.
quote: the measured flagpole height is stored inside BufferPoleHeight[] on the exact breakout candle

idea_name: Breakout tick-volume vs rolling volume MA filter
mechanism: PassesFilters optionally requires breakout-bar tick volume ≥ VolumeMultiplier × SMA(tick volume, VolumeMA_Period). Combined with optional SMA trend filter (close above/below MA on signal bar). Rejects low-participation flag breaks.
data_needed: CopyTickVolume around signal bar; VolumeMA_Period; VolumeMultiplier; optional MA handle
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD H4 validation run; filters optional inputs on Flag_Pattern_EA
why_new_for_mis: A reusable participation/liquidity gate on pattern breakouts—MIS can stream relative tick-volume as confirmation strength for any structural break sensor.
quote: the EA compares the breakout bar’s tick volume with its average volume value. If the breakout activity is too weak, the signal is rejected.

mechanism: Month-chunked MT5 tick/bar harvest into Parquet partitioned by year/month; Simulator.IS_TESTER switches copy_rates_*/copy_ticks_*/orders_*/positions_*/history_*/account_info/order_calc_* between parquet+containers and live MT5. Engineering toward an isolated Python strategy tester—no market-state sensor.
data_needed: TICKS_HISTORY_DIR / BARS_HISTORY_DIR parquet trees; symbol_info cache; tick_cache
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAUUSD; M1/M5/H1 examples; ~2022–2025 bar harvest
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—simulator API parity and storage only.
quote: instead of collecting all ticks at once … we iteratively collect ticks for every month and store the information into separate files

series_key: trading with the mql5 economic calendar
idea_name: Embedded calendar CSV with time/currency/impact window filter
mechanism: Live mode CalendarValueHistory → EconomicCalendar.csv embedded as #resource; tester LoadEventsFromResource. Per new bar, FilterAndPrintEvents keeps events in [barTime−HoursBefore/MinutesBefore, barTime+HoursAfter/MinutesAfter] ∩ date range, matching CurrencyFilter and ENUM_IMPORTANCE combinations (None/Low/Medium/High masks).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol/_Period; example download window 2025.03.01–2025.03.21; majors USD,EUR,GBP,JPY,AUD,NZD,CAD,CHF
why_new_for_mis: Makes economic-event proximity a deterministic, filterable sensing channel for MIS (impact×currency×time-to-release state) usable in both live and offline replay.
quote: loading news events from a resource file and applying user-defined filters to simulate live conditions in the Strategy Tester

series_key: using the mql5 economic calendar for news filter
idea_name: Static historical news window as deterministic risk regime
mechanism: On MQL_TESTER, LoadHistoricalNewsFromCSV into StaticNewsEvent[]; isUpcomingNews loops events filtered by importance mode and cached symbol currencies, returning true when TimeCurrent ∈ [event−NewsMinutesBefore, event+NewsMinutesAfter]. Live path keeps CalendarValueHistory. Overlaps merge into one continuous restriction window; validates block/suspend-stops/close-before-news behaviors.
data_needed: CSV event_time,currency,importance(1–3),event_name in Common\Files; currency cache; NewsMinutesBefore/After
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Symbol-relative currencies; test CSV examples 2024.01.15–16; ExportCalendarToCSV for year ranges
why_new_for_mis: Defines a reproducible news-risk regime sensor (in/out of high-impact window, overlapping merge) that MIS can align to volatility spikes and gate other sleeves during event regimes.
quote: Replace the live calendar query with a fast, in-memory search over the static data
